answer: One defence is Attested magistrate service with judiciary attestation: service the judiciary recorded across years of benches, and the quill of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents barely notice the check, because service the judiciary recorded across years of benches is something they already have; the lantern falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The prism grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
